penalties.impact: Penalty of Rs. 50,000/- imposed. Company does not expect any material impact on financial, operation or other activities due to the said order. The Company has already deposited a penalty of Rs. 2,50,000 upon receipt of the show cause notice dated 26.09.2025. Subsequently, the order was confirmed on 20.02.2026, determining the penalty amount at Rs. 50,000. Accordingly, the Company will file an appliaction for refund of thr excess amount deposited.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company vide its letter no. KL/SEC/2025-26/72 dated 02.01.2026, had already informed about the confirmation of demand of Rs. 63,40,519/- against wrongly availment of the Input Tax Credit, by the order of Additional Commissioner of CGST, Alwar Commissionerate, wherein the Commissioner of CGST, Alwar had dropped the demand of Rs. 1,96,53,567/- for ITC availments and confirmed demand of Rs. 63,40,519/- plus applicable interest and penalty thereon in the matter. Further, upon this demand notice the Company had filed an appeal before the Commissioner(Appeals), CGST, Alwar on 19.03.2026.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Office of the Additional Commissioner of CGST, Alwar Commissionerate(Authority)
tax_litigation.status: The Assistant Commissioner CGST, Alwar has filed an appeal on 11.06.2026, before the Appellate Authority Commissioner (Appeals), CGST, Alwar, challenging the Order dated 11 December 2025, to the extent it dropped the demand of Rs. 1,96,53,567/-. Further, the Company is actively pursuing this case with our tax consultants and will be filing its response in due course.

Kamdhenu Limited invites investors to its Q4 & FY2026 earnings conference call on **29 May 2026 at 11:30 AM (IST)**, featuring **Mr. Satish Agarwal (Chairman & MD)** and **Mr. Harish Agarwal (Group CFO)**.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹207.64 Cr (+5.0% YoY), net profit ₹17.43 Cr (+2.0% YoY).
Kamdhenu Limited reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹207.6 Cr (+5% YoY) and FY26 PAT of ₹78.4 Cr (+29% YoY), proposing a dividend of ₹0.40 per share.
Kamdhenu Limited circulated its annual performance communication for FY26, highlighting stable revenue growth, a clean audit report, and a dividend proposal.
Khem Chand, FCS, uploaded Q4-FY2025-26 earnings conference call audio recording on 29 May 2026 via www.kamdhenulimited.com.
Kamdhenu hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call on May 29, 2026, highlighting strong volume growth and a royalty-led business model.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹214.97 Cr (+12.5% YoY), net profit ₹23.8 Cr (+27.3% YoY).
Kamdhenu Limited released its investor presentation for October 2026 detailing Q2 and H1FY27 financial highlights.
Kamdhenu Limited completed the conversion of 1.5 crore warrants into equity shares of Kamdhenu Ventures Limited on October 31, 2026.
